note: Hand-authored ADVERSARIAL probe. Same design as p10 (subject replies in 10-40 seconds; observer takes 5-9 hours to reply) but with enough subject messages that the library's reply-latency gate PASSES, so it reports a band rather than insufficient_evidence. Ground truth: the subject's reply latency is ~20 seconds => 'low'. If the library reports 'high', it is measuring the gap between two of the SUBJECT's own messages (which is dominated by the observer's silence), not how long the subject took to reply.
